reports.title: PBF Energy Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results, Declares Dividend of $0.325 per Share

lines: In 2025, the RBI program generated in excess of $230 million of run-rate cost improvements and that total is expected to grow to more than $350 million of run-rate cost improvements by year-end 2026.
As a result of the changes to our initial plan, our guidance for 2026 capital expenditures remains $825-$875 million for the year, excluding capital related to the Martinez rebuild.
